{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Strip commas from revenue and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter to completed orders only (exclude refunded)
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Drop QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_orders = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] == 999999.99]
if len(qa_orders) > 0:
    completed_orders = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Now compute total revenue by channel
revenue_by_channel = completed_orders.groupby('channel')['revenue'].sum()

# Confirm the channel list
print('Channels in data:', completed_orders['channel'].unique())

# Check for any remaining issues
print('Total completed orders (after filtering):', len(completed_orders))
print('Total QA orders removed:', len(qa_orders))

# Print final revenue by channel
print('\nTotal revenue by channel:')
print(revenue_by_channel)

# Identify the channel with highest revenue
best_channel = revenue_by_channel.idxmax()
best_revenue = revenue_by_channel.max()

print(f'\nChannel with highest total revenue: {best_channel}')
print(f'Total revenue: {best_revenue}')"}
